user.title: Add Zonentra
user.description: Like Versatile Thermostat: first create the central configuration (building, outdoor unit groups and shared settings) once, then add every zone separately. Zonentra sets the outdoor unit stand per group; a room is only regulated once its Room regulation switch is on.

central.title: Central configuration
central.description: Choose a name and the outdoor temperature sensor. Everything else starts at the defaults: set the limits on the central device and the other subjects (presence, room regulation, screens, weather forecast, outdoor unit groups) via Configure.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: One room with its temperature sensor, indoor units (existing climate entities) and outdoor unit group. Disable a central choice to enter local values in the next step. The room gets its own Zonentra thermostat; its indoor units are only switched once its Room regulation switch is on.

data.name: Name
data.occupancy_entity: Motion sensor (optional; without motion the zone uses the eco band)
data.vane_entity: Vane (optional; select, number or switch entity of the indoor unit)
data.vane_cool_value: Vane when cooling (up): option, number, or on/off for a switch
data.vane_heat_value: Vane when heating (down): option, number, or on/off for a switch

zone_parameters.title: Local zone values
zone_parameters.description: These values apply only to this zone. Fixed comfort, eco and away limits are set on the zone's device.

data.sensor_validation: Sensor validation (state_based = default; update_based only for periodically reporting sensors)
data.max_age_seconds: Maximum update age for update_based (seconds; ignored by state_based)

init.title: Building topology
init.description: Edits remain provisional until Save. Closing the dialog discards them.

menu_options.group: Add or edit an outdoor unit group

general.title: General
general.description: Building-wide measurements and parameters for zones that use the central values. Outdoor temperature belongs to the whole building. Older outdoor sources still awaiting a choice: {outdoor_candidates}. Comfort, eco and away limits are set on the central device.

data.sensor_validation: Central sensor validation (state_based = default; update_based only for periodically reporting sensors)
data.max_age_seconds: Central maximum update age for update_based (seconds; ignored by state_based)

presence.title: Presence
presence.description: Building presence and motion choose between the comfort, eco and away band of each zone.

data.presence_entity: Building presence (binary_sensor, input_boolean, alarm panel, person, group or zone)

regulation.title: Room regulation
regulation.description: Only applies to rooms whose Room regulation switch is on, and to the outdoor unit stand control.

data.manual_override_enabled: Allow manual override via the room controller
data.min_on_seconds: Minimum indoor unit on-time before switching off (seconds; comfort)
data.min_off_seconds: Minimum indoor unit off-time before switching on (seconds; safety, check manufacturer)
data.changeover_wait_seconds: Wait between stopping and the opposite mode on a group switch (seconds; safety)
data.setpoint_max_offset: Maximum setpoint correction of an indoor unit (°C)
data.window_delay_seconds: Open window: delay before the room stops (seconds)

screens.title: Screens
screens.description: Sunshine from the solar power; wind and rain stay with the building's own alarms (block entity). Each room's Screen regulation switch decides whether screens really move.

data.sun_power_threshold: Solar power above which the sun shines (W)
data.screen_block_entity: Block entity, e.g. wind alarm (optional; on = no commands)

forecast.title: Weather forecast
forecast.description: The hourly forecast makes a day warm, neutral or cold: screens shade early on warm days, and heating or cooling starts later when the weather will do the work. Thresholds and margin are set on the central device.

data.weather_entity: Weather forecast (optional; warm/cold days for screens and fewer heat/cool changeovers)

zone_details.title: Zone
zone_details.description: Zones use the central configuration by default. Disable a building choice and press Next to enter local values. Existing local values remain available when switching back. Zonentra does not control equipment.

data.name: Name
data.occupancy_entity: Motion sensor (optional; without motion the zone uses the eco band)
data.sensor_validation: Sensor validation (state_based = default; update_based only for periodically reporting sensors)
data.max_age_seconds: Maximum update age for update_based (seconds; ignored by state_based)

group_details.title: Outdoor unit group
group_details.description: The feedback source must report heat, cool or off. Use reliable feedback, not a requested mode. Without feedback the actual mode stays unknown. Every proposal is read-only.

equipment_details.title: Equipment
equipment_details.description: Register each indoor unit (an existing climate entity) as HVAC equipment in its zone; several units per zone and per outdoor unit group are supported. Zonentra only reads mode, hvac_action, temperatures and fan mode. Optional links can be cleared. No equipment is controlled.

data.name: Name
data.entity_id: Physical entity (for HVAC: the indoor unit climate entity)

building.title: Central configuration
building.description: These analysis limits and parameters apply to zones that select building settings. Outdoor temperature always belongs to the whole building. Older outdoor sources still awaiting a choice: {outdoor_candidates}. No equipment is controlled. Manual override and anti-cycling settings only affect the simulated control plan; Zonentra 0.5 sends no commands.

legacy_configuration.title: Recreate Zonentra as central configuration and zones
legacy_configuration.description: The Zonentra entry "{name}" uses the pre-0.6 single-entry layout. It keeps working for now, but is deprecated. Remove it and add Zonentra again: first the central configuration, then each zone. Entity IDs will change.
